title: SourceEvent
description: Raw connector envelope accepted by POST /ingest. The payload stays in the source system's native shape; core normalizes it into an Activity. Connectors never write account state.

source_object_id.description: Stable id of the object in the source system (message id, call id, CRM record id).

source_event_key.description: Distinguishes events about the same object (e.g. 'created', 'stage:Negotiation', 'transcript_ready'). Together with source_system and source_object_id it forms the idempotency key.

occurred_at.description: When the event happened in the world, if the connector knows. Normalization may derive it from the payload instead.

allOf.description: dataset and synthetic events name their source; live events have none.
A synthetic event carries a versioned synthetic layer (WP32: synthetic:v1).
A synthetic provenance is only ever carried by a synthetic event.
